data.text:
Organizers announce “EDSA 40: Tuloy ang Laban sa Korapsyon at Kahirapan” protest on Feb. 25, 1-5 p.m. at EDSA Shrine, EDSA-Ortigas and People Power Monument.

The gathering marks the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution and calls for accountability from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Vice President Sara Duterte, and other officials over alleged corruption. | via @_izzylee
